verses.1: The words that came from Jehovah to Jeremiah were these:
verses.2: You rose and descended into the house of creation. May I fulfill your words.
verses.3: And the house of the maker came down, and he began to work with the stones.
verses.4: And the vessel he makes from wood, by the hands of the craftsman; then he turns it into another vessel, according to what the craftsman deems appropriate for its use.
verses.5: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to me.
verses.6: This maker cannot build a house for you in Israel. As Jehovah says, “Here, the wood is in the hands of the maker; yet you are in my hands, O Israel.”
verses.7: Let me speak about a nation and its king who is to be destroyed and overthrown.
verses.8: And that nation was freed from its evil deeds, those evil deeds about which I had spoken. I also forgave the harm that I had intended to do to them.
verses.9: And let me speak about a nation and its king, so that they may be built and strengthened.
verses.10: And he did evil in my eyes, so that I couldn’t hear his voice. I was offended by the good things I said about him.
verses.11: And now, say to the people of Judah and to the rulers of Jerusalem, “As Jehovah has said, ‘I will bring calamity upon you. I will have thoughts against you.’ Return from your evil ways! Correct your ways and stop being wicked.”
verses.12: And they said, “After our own thoughts, we will go forth. But those who have a wicked heart will be brought to ruin.”
verses.13: Therefore, the LORD said, “Let those who are in the nations ask themselves: Who has created such wonderful things in the land of Israel?”
verses.14: Let him leave the icy dens of winter and return to springtime. If he is troubled by foreign, cold waters, then let him be freed from them.
verses.15: For my people have forgotten me; they will fail in their efforts to follow the path of eternity. They will not be able to walk along that path at all.
verses.16: Let their land be filled with the sound of eternal laughter. All that lies upon it will be destroyed, and it will be turned into dust.
verses.17: May their spirits be scattered before the day breaks, and may they not be seen on that day.
verses.18: And they said, “Go, and let the judgment be pronounced upon Jeremias. For the law will not be destroyed from the priest, nor advice from the wise men, nor words from the prophets. Go, and condemn him by the sword. Do not listen to any of his words.”
verses.19: May Jehovah listen to me, and may He hear the voice of my enemies.
verses.20: May evil be under good, for they have taken away my joy. I stand before you to speak about them. It is good to restore your kindness from them.
verses.21: Therefore, you shall give them over to starvation and let them be destroyed by the sword. Their women shall become widows, and their men shall die in battle.
verses.22: They heard a cry from their women, as if they were about to be brought down suddenly by a storm. They were trapped and had no way to escape.
verses.23: And you, Jehovah, know all their plans regarding their deaths. Do not let their sins and transgressions stand before you. Let them fail in your hands when you act upon them.
